extracted.name: Garam Masala Spice Blend
extracted.description: Garam masala is a spicy blend of aromatic spices and chiles from northern India. Make it at home, and you'll never want to use the store bought blend again.
ingredient_lines: 2 dried red chile peppers, seeds discarded
instruction_lines: Combine the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, cardamom seeds, peppercorns, fennel seeds, mustard seeds, cloves, and red chile peppers in a small skillet over medium-low heat. Toast until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Grind the toasted spices in a clean coffee grinder or spice mill to a fine powder. Spoon in the turmeric, and process to combine. Use immediately, or store in a sealed jar for up to 1 month.
